description: Columbus, MS — District Attorney Scott Colom, candidate for U.S. Senate, today announced a community goods drive to collect essential supplies for Mississippi families recovering from the May 6 tornadoes that tore through Brookhaven, Bogue Chitto, and other communities across southwest Mississippi.

title: District Attorney Scott Colom Launches Community Goods Drive for Mississippi Families Hit by May 6 Tornadoes - Scott Colom for Senate
